client.description: The v3 query client the creators are built on, e.g. `apiClient` (or its `apiClientConfig`). Its generated helpers (`apiGet`, `apiPostSecure`, …) must exist - run `migrate-to-query-v3` first.

clientImport.description: Where the client helpers are imported from: a module specifier (e.g. `@app/queries`) or a workspace file (e.g. `libs/queries/src/lib/api.client.ts`).

publicRoutes.description: Comma separated route prefixes that are public, e.g. `/public,/status`. Every other route gets the secure helper. Without it every creator uses the public helper.

serviceApiBase.description: The `ServiceBase` API base the client points at, as written in the services (e.g. `environment.apiBaseURL`). Required when the services use more than one; features on the others are left alone.

projects.description: Nx projects to migrate. Defaults to every project in the workspace.

include.description: Path prefixes to migrate, relative to the workspace root (e.g. 'libs/store'). Unioned with `projects`. Defaults to the whole workspace.
